# GET /api/auth/me

Read the current authenticated identity and organization scope.

Accepts a user access JWT through Authorization Bearer or the configured access cookie.
An explicit Authorization header takes precedence and never falls back to cookies.
Cookie mode renews missing or expired access through the refresh cookie and returns
replacement HttpOnly cookies when Origin is trusted, or a safe request has
Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin. No credentials are returned in JSON.
Access claims contain a cached role; session revocation and membership changes are
checked on renewal rather than on every access-token request.

## Authentication

Satisfy one of these alternatives (schemes within one alternative are all required):

- `{"bearerAuth":[]}`



```json
{
  "scheme": "bearer",
  "type": "http"
}
```
- `{"accessCookie":[]}`

HttpOnly access cookie; nonsecure local development uses compallm-access. Automatic renewal additionally requires the configured refresh cookie.

```json
{
  "description": "HttpOnly access cookie; nonsecure local development uses compallm-access. Automatic renewal additionally requires the configured refresh cookie.",
  "in": "cookie",
  "name": "__Host-access",
  "type": "apiKey"
}
```

## Example request

```bash
curl --request GET 'https://compallm.example/api/auth/me'
```

Replace URL parameters and supply any required query values and authentication described above.

## Responses

### 200

Current identity; cookie renewal may set replacement cookies

Content type: `application/json`.

Identity and organization scope from the current signed access credential.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| organizationId | integer | true | Organization selected for this session. |
| organizationRole | string | true | Cached membership role from the access JWT, refreshed on renewal. |
| sessionId | integer | true | Current login session identifier. |
| userId | integer | true | Authenticated user identifier. |
